what: Build + local land of the issue-2 presentation layer for the 34 CIE canonical bundles: sha1-verified PDF fetch, geometry-driven R2 re-recovery (42 recovered rows / 7 T6-proven / 29 honest unrecovered), issue-2 emitter (text_render on all 6,920 rows), gate battery G-F5-C1..C6 ALL PASS, census 0.6 rider (additivity CLEAN), swap staged under download/w-f5-swap/ (34 modified spec_points.json + SWAP.md sha256 pins).

phase_a_fetch.note: mismatched PDFs are NOT the pinned sources (Cambridge re-issued); their R2 candidate rows fall back honestly to unrecovered

phase_b_recovery.note: 42 verdicts cover 40 unique (qual,id) rows — 2 rows match multiple detector classes and were recovered twice with byte-identical results (deterministic engine)
phase_b_recovery.acceptance_law: STRICT: insertions from verified sub/sup spans only, deletions spaces/control-glyph only; RELAXED: additions from verified evidence, no content lost, reorder receipted; recovery text convention = plain inline digits (corpus-consistent); render re-encodes those positions to unicode sub/sup

phase_c_emit.row_shape: 13-field contract + text_render (14 fields), text_render inserted after text
phase_c_emit.serialization: indent=1, ensure_ascii=False, no trailing newline (byte-format-identical to issue-1)
phase_c_emit.swap: download/w-f5-swap/ (34 spec_points.json + SWAP.md sha256 pins + swap-manifest.json with per-row position receipts)

gates.G-F5-C1: PASS — de-render(text_render) == text on 6920/6920 rows (position receipts invert T-edits; unicode map inverts R2 rows)
gates.G-F5-C3: PASS — issue-1 flags preserved; reparse-2.0 only on receipted R2 rows
gates.G-F5-C4: PASS — issue '2', 14-field order, counts honest, topics.json untouched (byte-identical pinned oids)
gates.G-F5-C5: PASS — exactly 34 staged files, SWAP.md pins match
gates.G-F5-C6: PASS — every reparse-2.0 row carries page/span/acceptance receipt; 4 sha1-mismatch quals documented

phase_e_census.rider: 0.5 -> 0.6 (seq 8): 34 CIE rows gain bundle_issue "2" + text_render true; deep-compare additivity CLEAN

landing: LOCAL ONLY — commits built on the remote tip fetched at build time; PUSH PENDING OPERATOR ORDER (no fresh credential delegated this round; the prior PAT is under standing rotation advice)
next_operator_action: push the two landing commits (fresh PAT or manual push); rotate the outstanding PAT
